verdict.rationale: The only documented multi-item action is in Quo's first-party MCP integration, which can broadcast the same text to multiple team members in a single request. Nothing documents bulk updates, deletes or imports across contacts, conversations or calls, and the API docs describe only per-request rate limits, with no batch endpoints. Missing for 10: general bulk/batch operations across item types (e.g., bulk contact updates or imports), documented batch API endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Send a text to one person or broadcast the same message to multiple team members from your Quo number, without opening your workspace.
